sources.verified_angle_summary: During the first day of LEAP 2026, Saudi telecom operator Mobily and global technology leader Nokia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to accelerate the transition towards smarter, more efficient, and sustainable networks. The partnership focuses on deploying artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to enhance the performance and efficiency of wireless networks. Key areas of collaboration include optimizing network resource utilization, promoting operational sustainability, and improving overall customer experience. Furthermore, the agreement sets the stage for exploring new AI-powered use cases and services within the telecommunications sector. This strategic move aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 goals of building a competitive digital economy and reinforces the Kingdom's position as a regional hub for technology and innovation. This verified announcement provides a concrete, non-duplicated story distinct from Mobily's other activities, such as its previous collaborations with Ericsson, offering strong material for an in-depth telecom infrastructure feature.
